risks.risk: The headlight may not be genuine or may be from a different brand than claimed (Hyundai or Kia).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the headlight's mounting points, backside, or any part number/label, or a photo showing the headlight installed on a Hyundai or Kia vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-genuine or generic, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The headlight may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lens, broken internal components).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens and internal reflectors, and a video showing the headlight being turned on and off.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with major defects, reducing value.

risks.risk: The headlight may be missing parts (e.g., bulb, wiring harness, or mounting hardware).
risks.proof: A photo showing the entire headlight assembly with all components included, or a video demonstrating the full set.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the back of the headlight showing any part numbers or brand markings.
A photo of the headlight installed on a Hyundai or Kia vehicle to verify authenticity.
A close-up of the lens and internal components to check for cracks or damage.
A video showing the headlight being turned on and off to confirm functionality.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
